  <file path="src/services/user.ts">
    function mapPrismaUser(user: {
      id: string;
      email: string;
      name: string | null;
      picture: string | null;
      emailVerified: boolean;
      preferences: unknown;
      createdAt: Date;
      updatedAt: Date;
    }): User { /* implementation omitted */ }
    userService = {
      async list(page: number, limit: number): Promise<PaginatedResponse<User>> {
        const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
    
        const [users, total] = await Promise.all([
          prisma.user.findMany({
            skip,
            take: limit,
            orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
          }),
          prisma.user.count(),
        ]);
    
        const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);
    
        return {
          data: users.map(mapPrismaUser),
          pagination: {
            page,
            limit,
            total,
            totalPages,
            hasNext: page < totalPages,
            hasPrev: page > 1,
          },
        };
      },
    
      async getById(id: string): Promise<User | null> {
        const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id } });
        return user ? mapPrismaUser(user) : null;
      },
    
      async getByEmail(email: string): Promise<User | null> {
        const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
        return user ? mapPrismaUser(user) : null;
      },
    
      async create(data: CreateUserRequest): Promise<User> {
        const user = await prisma.user.create({
          data: {
            email: data.email,
            name: data.name ?? null,
            picture: data.picture ?? null,
          },
        });
        return mapPrismaUser(user);
      },
    
      /**
       * Finds a user by email or creates one if not found.
       * Uses upsert to prevent race conditions when two concurrent
       * first-login requests arrive for the same email.
       */
      async findOrCreate(data: CreateUserRequest): Promise<User> {
        const user = await prisma.user.upsert({
          where: { email: data.email },
          update: {}, // No-op if user already exists
          create: {
            email: data.email,
            name: data.name ?? null,
            picture: data.picture ?? null,
          },
        });
        return mapPrismaUser(user);
      },
    
      async update(id: string, data: UpdateUserRequest): Promise<User | null> {
        try {
          const user = await prisma.user.update({
            where: { id },
            data: {
              ...(data.name !== undefined && { name: data.name }),
              ...(data.picture !== undefined && { picture: data.picture }),
            },
          });
          return mapPrismaUser(user);
        } catch {
          return null;
        }
      },
    
      async delete(id: string): Promise<boolean> {
        try {
          await prisma.user.delete({ where: { id } });
          return true;
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          // Prisma P2025 = record not found
          if (err && typeof err === "object" && "code" in err && err.code === "P2025") {
            return false;
          }
          throw err;
        }
      },
    
      async updatePreferences(
        id: string,
        preferences: UpdatePreferencesRequest
      ): Promise<User | null> {
        try {
          const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id } });
          if (!user) return null;
    
          const currentPrefs = (user.preferences as UserPreferences) ?? {};
          const newPrefs = { ...currentPrefs, ...preferences };
    
          const updated = await prisma.user.update({
            where: { id },
            data: { preferences: newPrefs },
          });
          return mapPrismaUser(updated);
        } catch {
          return null;
        }
      },
    }

    export const UserPreferencesSchema: { readonly $id: "UserPreferences"; readonly type: "object"; readonly description: "User preference settings for UI and notifications"; readonly properties: { readonly theme: { readonly type: "string"; readonly enum: readonly ["light", "dark", "system"]; readonly description: "UI theme preference"; readonly example: "system"; }; readonly emailNotifications: { readonly type: "boolean"; readonly description: "Whether to receive email notifications for account activity"; readonly example: true; }; readonly marketingEmails: { readonly type: "boolean"; readonly description: "Whether to receive marketing and promotional emails"; readonly example: false; }; }; };
    export const UserSchema: { readonly $id: "User"; readonly type: "object"; readonly description: "A user account in the system"; readonly required: readonly ["id", "email", "emailVerified", "createdAt", "updatedAt"]; readonly properties: { readonly id: { readonly type: "string"; readonly description: "Unique identifier for the user"; readonly example: "clx1234567890abcdef"; }; readonly email: { readonly type: "string"; readonly format: "email"; readonly description: "User's email address"; readonly example: "user@example.com"; }; readonly name: { readonly type: "string"; readonly nullable: true; readonly description: "User's display name"; readonly example: "John Doe"; }; readonly picture: { readonly type: "string"; readonly format: "uri"; readonly nullable: true; readonly description: "URL to the user's profile picture"; readonly example: "https://example.com/avatars/user.jpg"; }; readonly emailVerified: { readonly type: "boolean"; readonly description: "Whether the user's email has been verified"; readonly example: true; }; readonly preferences: { readonly $ref: "UserPreferences#"; readonly description: "User's preference settings"; }; readonly createdAt: { readonly type: "string"; readonly format: "date-time"; readonly description: "Timestamp when the user was created"; readonly example: "2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z"; }; readonly updatedAt: { readonly type: "string"; readonly format: "date-time"; readonly description: "Timestamp when the user was last updated"; readonly example: "2024-01-20T14:45:00.000Z"; }; }; };
    export const PaginationSchema: { readonly $id: "Pagination"; readonly type: "object"; readonly description: "Pagination metadata for list responses"; readonly required: readonly ["page", "limit", "total", "totalPages", "hasNext", "hasPrev"]; readonly properties: { readonly page: { readonly type: "number"; readonly description: "Current page number (1-indexed)"; readonly example: 1; }; readonly limit: { readonly type: "number"; readonly description: "Number of items per page"; readonly example: 10; }; readonly total: { readonly type: "number"; readonly description: "Total number of items across all pages"; readonly example: 42; }; readonly totalPages: { readonly type: "number"; readonly description: "Total number of pages"; readonly example: 5; }; readonly hasNext: { readonly type: "boolean"; readonly description: "Whether there is a next page"; readonly example: true; }; readonly hasPrev: { readonly type: "boolean"; readonly description: "Whether there is a previous page"; readonly example: false; }; }; };
    export const ErrorSchema: { readonly $id: "Error"; readonly type: "object"; readonly description: "Standard error response"; readonly required: readonly ["error", "message", "statusCode"]; readonly properties: { readonly error: { readonly type: "string"; readonly description: "Error type or category"; readonly example: "Not Found"; }; readonly message: { readonly type: "string"; readonly description: "Human-readable error message"; readonly example: "User not found"; }; readonly statusCode: { readonly type: "number"; readonly description: "HTTP status code"; readonly example: 404; }; }; };
